agreed: 2026-11-19 (SCHOOL UPDATE, master blueprint section 80; limits and registers built in section 4, row 80.15)
rule: LynkSchool serves every kind and level of school (80.1). A school picks its kind and sees only what it needs; prices, limits, events and rules never change by kind. The school year, grading, offline working and every safety rule are on every tier. Children's data serves only that child's schooling and is never used for advertising; a learner under 18 holds no account of their own; a child's photo goes only to that child's guardians with consent; court or school limits on a household are enforced. LynkAssist drafts and explains; a named person decides. Read through core/school.py; the screens come in sections 4B, 7B, 8, 8B, 9B, 13 and 14 (80.15).

year.from: country pack (unknown until confirmed: the safe default is terms)
year.grading: any scale the school sets; report cards in up to two languages

never: a child's photo beyond that child's guardians without consent
blocking a learner by itself (money is never a reason LynkSchool locks a learner out)
a drop-out warning that is more than a flag for a named person

may: draft report comments for the teacher
lesson plans from the country's curriculum
plain answers from the school's own records
timetable and cover proposals for the head
explain a report card simply to a guardian
never: report on a child by itself
see safeguarding, counselling or clinic notes
talk with a child under 18 outside the school's or a guardian's account
use a child's data for anything but that child's schooling

build.4B: observations, appraisal and licence reminders with LynkHR
build.8: counselling, room, lab and facility booking
build.9B: everything else, with LynkAssist's skills of 80.16
build.13: LynkKiosk at the gate and library, LynkDScreen notice board
